content_sections.heading: Narayanpet ICDS Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: The Department of Women, Child, Disabled and Senior Citizens Welfare, Narayanpet District, Telangana, has officially released Notification No. 740/AR/2026 dated 11 September 2026 for the recruitment of Anganwadi Teacher and Anganwadi Helper posts. A total of 65 vacancies have been announced across the Maddur, Makthal and Narayanpet ICDS projects, including 31 Anganwadi Teacher and 34 Anganwadi Helper vacancies. The notification includes details on project-wise vacancies, eligibility criteria, age limit, local residence requirements, selection process, reservation rules and online application procedure. Candidates are strongly advised to read the complete notification carefully before applying. Eligible local women candidates can submit their applications online from 15 September 2026 to 30 September 2026, up to 5:00 PM. content_sections.heading: Narayanpet ICDS Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Candidates planning to apply for the Narayanpet Anganwadi Teacher and Helper Recruitment 2026 should note the following dates from the official notification. The interview date, selection list, and further schedule are not specified in the notification and will be announced separately by the District Selection Committee.

content_sections.heading: Narayanpet ICDS Anganwadi Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 65 posts are being filled across the three ICDS projects of Narayanpet district. All 34 Anganwadi Helper vacancies listed in the notification are specifically for candidates from tribal (Girijan) areas.

content_sections.heading: Narayanpet ICDS Anganwadi 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for Anganwadi Teacher and Anganwadi Helper posts must have passed Intermediate (12th class) as the mandatory educational qualification. For the Anganwadi Helper post specifically, if no candidate with Intermediate/12th class qualification is available in a given area, a candidate with a lower qualification (SSC) will be considered for selection.

content_sections.heading: Narayanpet ICDS Anganwadi 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: Candidates must be between 18 and 35 years of age as on 1 July 2026. Before submitting the application, candidates are advised to verify that they meet the required age criteria. Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date. The notification invites applications from eligible women candidates only, for both Anganwadi Teacher and Anganwadi Helper posts. Candidates for both Anganwadi Teacher and Anganwadi Helper posts must be local women residents. In urban (Municipality) areas, the candidate must reside in the same ward where the Anganwadi Centre is located. In rural areas, the candidate must reside in the same Gram Panchayat where the Anganwadi Centre is located.

content_sections.heading: Narayanpet ICDS Anganwadi Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection of candidates for Narayanpet Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 is based on a total of 100 marks, distributed as follows: Every Anganwadi Centre reserved under the ST roster has been categorised project-wise into ST Group-1, ST Group-II, or ST Group-III. Eligible candidates belonging to the allotted group are given first preference. If candidates are not available within the allotted group, the vacancy is filled with candidates from other ST sub-categories as per the applicable reservation rules. For Anganwadi Teacher posts allocated to the ST category under the ST Sub-Plan, ST candidates from the same village/Gram Panchayat (or the same ward, in municipal areas) are eligible. While considering persons with disabilities for Anganwadi Teacher selection, the guidelines issued vide G.O.Ms.No.39, dated 6 September 2011, by the Department of Women, Child, Disabled and Senior Citizens Welfare will be followed.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Narayanpet ICDS Anganwadi Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online only, through the official website http://wdcw.tg.nic.in . Manual applications sent by post, e-mail, or submitted in person at the CDPO/DWO office will not be accepted. Visit the official website: http://wdcw.tg.nic.in. Find the Narayanpet ICDS Anganwadi Teacher & Helper Recruitment 2026 notification link. Fill in the online application form with accurate personal, educational, age, and locality details before the last date. Submit the application online before 30 September 2026, 5:00 PM. Take a printout of the submitted application. Candidates who apply online must submit photocopies of their certificates related to educational qualification, age, and local residence, along with a copy of their application, to the concerned ICDS office. These certificate copies must be attested by a Gazetted Officer. The District Collector, Narayanpet District, holds full authority to cancel the notification completely or make changes to it.

faq.question: Q1. What is Narayanpet ICDS Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by the Department of Women, Child, Disabled and Senior Citizens Welfare, Narayanpet District, to fill 65 vacant Anganwadi Teacher and Anganwadi Helper posts across the Maddur, Makthal, and Narayanpet ICDS projects, under Notification No. 740/AR/2026 dated 11 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Narayanpet Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 65 total vacancies: 31 Anganwadi Teacher posts and 34 Anganwadi Helper posts (Helper posts reserved for tribal/Girijan area candidates).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Narayanpet Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application last date is 30 September 2026 (Wednesday), up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Narayanpet Anganwadi posts?
faq.answer: Intermediate (12th class) pass is mandatory. For the Helper post only, if no Intermediate-qualified candidate is available, SSC-qualified candidates may be considered.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Narayanpet Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 18 and 35 years of age as on 1 July 2026.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply online for Narayanpet Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official website http://wdcw.tg.nic.in. Offline applications sent by post, e-mail, or submitted in person are not accepted.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for Narayanpet Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on 100 total marks: 70 marks for Intermediate/12th class merit, 5 marks for widows, 10 marks for orphans, 5 marks for persons with disabilities, and 10 marks for a District Selection Committee interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for Narayanpet Anganwadi Teacher and Helper posts?
faq.answer: The salary is not specified in the official notification.
